title: A stylesheet the agent writes with bash or a file tool is checked on the page: a WordPress theme style.css the page does not link answers CSS_FILE_NOT_LOADED (not done, the sheets the page loads named), a linked or combined one is recorded loaded, EmDash is checked at the next site.rebuild
steps: S1: node --test packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/css-file-loaded-wiring.test.mjs (the real tools/execute + tools/post-execute listeners of lib/index.js; container file read by sh, curl answered from a table)
expect: S1: a bash append to wp-content/themes/tracy/style.css on a home page that links only assets/css/app-pair.css and marketing.css gives the call's result a block cssFile:not loaded with warning CSS_FILE_NOT_LOADED and a next starting 'Do not tell the customer it is done' naming app-pair.css; a linked style.css gives cssFile:loaded; a write that changed nothing reads no page; an EmDash /app/src edit says nothing until site.rebuild, whose result names global.css loaded (its rule in /_astro/…) and a new extra.css nothing imports not loaded, once

S2: written paths map to served URLs on WordPress, Joomla (T4 local/css, media/templates/site) and EmDash (src built, public copied); a T4 media/t4/optimize sheet holding the written selector and properties is loaded, a stale one is not; a child theme's @import, a ?ver or asset-hash query and a site in a folder are loaded; a page, sheet or file not read, or past the budget, is unchecked

selectors.host: css-file-loaded.mjs CSS_FILE_NOT_LOADED cssFilesLoaded cssFileAnswer; index.ts noteCssWrites + tools/post-execute

fence: A stylesheet the page does not load is never answered as done

tests: 🔒 WordPress: a bash append to a style.css the home page does not link
WordPress: the same append to a style.css the page links
🔒 EmDash: a source edit waits for site.rebuild
🔒 WordPress, a theme whose style.css the page does not load
🔒 Joomla T4: a file T4 combines into media/t4/optimize
